lead: A `.nvst` case cannot put non-UTF-8 octets on disk, so a binary probe file has no writer today.
body: `Core\IO::write` and `Core\IO\File::write` take `CoreTy::Text(Qual::Neutral)`, so writing a `bytes` is `E0401`, and a NUL or lone `0xFF` cannot travel through an argument vector either. A bytes row on `Core\IO` or `Core\Storage::put` is a member change, not a case.
